title: A recording handed to Photonz as it starts opens in its own window
goal: Double-clicking a recording in Finder (or dropping it on the Dock icon) while Photonz is not running should open it, the way a picture does. Today nothing opens: the app starts and the recording is never shown.
notes:
Reproduced 2026-10-19 while building the agent channel (an-agent-can-reach-the-running-app-read-the-open). Commands, run twice with the same result:

  Scripts/probe-app.sh --quit; open -g -a "$PWD/dist/Photonz Probe.app" "/tmp/photonz-agent-try/Demo recording.mp4"; sleep 10
  then the agent tool list_documents (printf the tools/call line | PHOTONZ_APP=probe Scripts/photonz-mcp.sh) answers []

The same with Busy screenshot 800x500.png answers one picture document (after the agent registry also notes editors in canvasDidMoveToWindow). Opening the same recording AFTER launch (open_document, which calls AppCoordinator.openFileWindow) opens it fine, in a new 1728x990 window. Likely cause, not confirmed: AppCoordinator.openRecording has `guard openWindowAction != nil else { NSWorkspace.shared.activateFileViewerSelecting([url]); return }`, and openWindowAction is captured from the menu-bar scene in a .task (PhotonzApp.swift ~199), which may not have run when the launch-time open arrives. A picture goes through EditorView.onOpenURL -> openPicked -> openImage into the window SwiftUI made, so it never needs openWindowAction. Fix idea: hold the URL and open it once openWindowAction is set, instead of revealing in Finder.
acceptance: With Photonz quit, opening a recording file with it opens that recording in an editor window, at Next defaults
The same for a picture still works (it does today)
A walk or a script check that starts the probe with a recording shows the recording window open
